acceptance: The maintainer decides: keep the rule, or map SWF with no defects to DO_NOT_SHIP or to an incomplete verdict
If the rule changes, protocol.judge and test_protocol.py change with it
context: 2026-10-09 tracker review: dropped. The rule (SHIP_WITH_FIXES with no listed defects becomes SHIP) is the recorded decision (_project/decisions/oracle-review-protocol-2026-10-08.md:31-34, _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/protocol.py:309-313). The evidence is one PR (#2783). A malformed finding invalidates the whole verdict (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/verdict.py:200-213), so a reviewer cannot slip a bad defect list through. Reopen if a real case appears where an empty-defect SHIP_WITH_FIXES hid a problem.
description: protocol.judge computes the decision from the defect list, so a reviewer answering SHIP_WITH_FIXES with no listed defects is recorded as SHIP and passes. This follows the maintainer's specified rule (SWF with 0 defects becomes SHIP). The shadow oracle raised it as a Medium three times on #2783, arguing that it loosens the reviewer's stated outcome, especially on inline briefs where no read evidence applies. Each time it was deferred as a maintainer decision.
